arStrings.szText:
For the next {c_number}{s1}{/c} minutes:
{icon:bullet}Enemies take {c_number}20%{/c} more damage from your attacks.
{icon:bullet}Enemies routinely drop additional {c_materials}Herbs{/c} and {c_materials}Crafting Materials{/c}.
{icon:bullet}You gain {c_number}15%{/c} increased Experience.

You may only have one Elixir active at a time.

During activities that do not normally drop items, rewards will appear on completion.
